parsed.rationale: One participating record lives at 'Shared/Wallpaper/Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/Sources/DebugHUD.swift', which sits under the canonical Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/ directory — a sample-app location that triggers the sample-app-mirror restraint regardless of the is_sample_app flag value.
